item.title: PHA Accepts Ruling, Bay St Break-Ins, Ankle Monitor
item.ns0:title: PHA Accepts Ruling, Bay St Break-Ins, Ankle Monitor
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the Public Hospitals Authority breaks its silence on a landmark negligence ruling involving the tragic death of a newborn at Princess Margaret Hospital. We investigate a string of brazen overnight break-ins targeting longtime businesses in the heart of downtown Nassau and take an in-depth look at the effectiveness of the ankle monitoring system amidst rising safety concerns. Plus, a community in Bimini speaks out after a 9-year-old boy is mauled by roaming dogs, and we bring you the latest on a major $29 million government health care expansion and local stars shining on the international sports stage.
